description: Graduate a sold-out MomoSwap NFT drop (phase `sold-out` in get_nft_drop). Permissionless: anyone may send it, usually a keeper does. It locks the floor share of the raise for nft_drop_redeem, releases the creator's share to nft_drop_claim and ends sell-backs. A drop with a raise target graduates on the buy that reaches it, so this only applies at sell-out. Network fee only. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (or any of its items' mints)

name: nft_drop_graduate
title: Graduate a sold-out NFT drop
